name: THE PIT
source:
The world doesn't end with a crack.
It ends with a wet, sucking sound.
Not in fire. In rot.
It doesn't collapse - it festers.
And in that decay -

The Pit.

A sealed, sepulchral, sacred-in-its-filth prison - into which the centuries have thrown everything that doesn't fit the order: heretics, witches, soldiers who lost their wars, women who spoke too loudly, and men who spoke in the wrong voice.

But sometimes...

...the Pit receives the Great.

[From [url=https://sleepyracoongames.itch.io/beastborn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界不会因裂缝而终结。
它以潮湿、吸吮的声音结束。
不在火中。腐烂中。
它不会崩溃——它会溃烂。
在那衰败中——

坑。

一座密封的、阴森的、肮脏中神圣的监狱——几个世纪以来，所有不符合秩序的人都被扔进了监狱：异教徒、女巫、战败的士兵、说话太大声的女人，以及用错误的声音说话的男人。

但有时…

…深坑接待了伟大的人。

[来自[url=https://sleepyracoongames.itch.io/beastborn]itch.io[/url]]
